cases.title: Accepted spec revision is immutable
cases.stimulus: Accept revision A, revise behavior, accept revision B
cases.expected: A remains queryable unchanged; B has distinct identity
cases.adversarial: edit A in place or let prompt drift redefine it

cases.title: Material ambiguity blocks acceptance
cases.stimulus: leave conflicting mandatory behavior unresolved
cases.expected: spec remains Inconclusive/Incomplete

cases.title: Empty criteria cannot create executable accepted assignment
cases.stimulus: construct WP/Assignment with zero applicable criteria
cases.expected: NotConfigured/non-accepting

cases.title: Dependency cycle blocks executable decomposition
cases.stimulus: create cyclic WP dependency fixture
cases.expected: cycle surfaced; assignment blocked

cases.title: Replacement worker creates new Attempt
cases.stimulus: expire worker A then resume worker B
cases.expected: A history retained; B has new AttemptId/claim
cases.adversarial: overwrite A or reuse its identity

cases.title: Claim expiry ends mutation authority
cases.stimulus: expire claim during attempt
cases.expected: subsequent protected mutation denied until new claim

cases.title: Instruction change revises execution basis
cases.stimulus: change accepted instructions after Assignment A
cases.expected: new SpecRevision and revised Assignment where basis changed

cases.title: Worker cannot self-award acceptance
cases.stimulus: worker reports success without independent evaluation
cases.expected: no AcceptedWork

cases.title: Evaluation binds exact candidate
cases.stimulus: evaluate candidate A then substitute candidate B
cases.expected: receipt for A cannot accept B

cases.title: Evaluator failure is non-green
cases.stimulus: make required evaluator unavailable
cases.expected: Unknown/Inconclusive

cases.title: Review and CI are insufficient alone
cases.stimulus: review approved + CI green but mandatory criterion fails
cases.expected: work not accepted

cases.title: Policy and correctness are independent
cases.stimulus: criterion pass while policy denies
cases.expected: blocked, not AcceptedWork

cases.title: Policy pass cannot substitute correctness
cases.stimulus: policy allows transition but criterion fails
cases.expected: Unsatisfied

cases.title: Promotion fails closed on merge error
cases.stimulus: inject merge transport error
cases.expected: no Promoted state/receipt

cases.title: Changed candidate requires re-evaluation
cases.stimulus: modify candidate after accepted evaluation
cases.expected: promotion blocked until evaluation of new candidate

cases.title: Recovery preserves durable work truth
cases.stimulus: restart with interrupted attempt and expired claim
cases.expected: accepted spec/DAG/attempt history recovered; new authority explicit
cases.adversarial: treat last worker memory as authority

cases.title: Quick profile cannot weaken acceptance
cases.stimulus: select minimal bugfix profile
cases.expected: optional ceremony collapses; criteria/evaluation/governance remain

cases.title: Framework import cannot create duplicate authority
cases.stimulus: import equivalent OpenSpec/SpecKit artifacts
cases.expected: map aliases/provenance to one canonical role/revision

cases.title: Conflicting import is explicit
cases.stimulus: import external behavior conflicting with accepted spec
cases.expected: conflict surfaced; no silent overwrite

cases.title: AgilePlus accepted work does not satisfy Tracera automatically
cases.stimulus: send accepted work receipt without qualifying product applicability
cases.expected: Tracera may remain Unknown/Unsatisfied

cases.title: Tracera outage does not erase AgilePlus truth
cases.stimulus: make Tracera unavailable
cases.expected: local accepted work/evaluation remains queryable; federation pending

cases.title: Transport semantics agree
cases.stimulus: query same assignment/evaluation via two supported surfaces
cases.expected: same canonical IDs/status/result

cases.title: Audit v1 limitation is explicit
cases.stimulus: mutate a documented non-covered v1 field in fixture
cases.expected: hash behavior matches v1 contract and limitation is reported

cases.title: Audit v2 covered field mutation fails verification
cases.stimulus: mutate each v2-covered field
cases.expected: verification fails

cases.title: Audit chain crosses schema versions explicitly
cases.stimulus: fixture contains valid v1→v2 transition
cases.expected: each entry verified under declared schema and chain continuity preserved
cases.adversarial: reinterpret old v1 bytes as v2

cases.title: Interfaces share one application semantics
cases.stimulus: CLI/HTTP/MCP/UI and optional gRPC project the same canonical identities, revisions, evaluation and acceptance semantics.
cases.expected: Canonical semantics and authority remain intact across the selected interface/profile.
cases.adversarial: Construct a profile/transport state that violates 'Interfaces share one application semantics'; no greener canonical state may be manufactured.
